qualifier: from glycosylase cleavage to gap filling
name: Base excision repair from glycosylase cleavage to gap filling
rationale: All members are steps of base excision repair (glycosylase recognition and base cleavage, AP-site resolution, short- and long-patch gap filling); unlike confusables it covers the normal repair sequence end to end rather than glycosylase disease variants, NEIL/ICL or alkylation reversal.

qualifier: with intra-S checkpoint and genome stability
name: Mitotic DNA replication control with intra-S checkpoint and genome stability
rationale: Members concern initiation and restraint of mitotic DNA replication plus checkpoint signalling, recombination-intermediate resolution and p53-driven repair gene expression; confusables emphasise ATR replication-stress activation or DNA unwinding/break-induced replication.

qualifier: with general organic and amino acid metabolism
name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with organic acid metabolism
rationale: Specific members are phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism and phenylketonuria, joined by broad (obsolete) organic and amino acid terms; confusables add other amino acids (histidine, proline, threonine), BH4 synthesis or glycine conjugation.

name: Positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: All three members enhance NK- or T cell-mediated killing; confusables carry negative regulation, degranulation, NK/T cell signature modules or MHC class Ib presentation instead.

name: ROS detoxification and NADPH-supported redox homeostasis
rationale: Members cover ROS/hydroperoxide detoxification, cell redox balance and NAD(P)H supply via isocitrate and NADP+ synthesis; confusables centre on ferroptosis, aldehyde/methylglyoxal detoxification, protein repair or ascorbate metabolism.

qualifier: ammonium homeostasis and inherited enzyme defects
name: Urea cycle, ammonium homeostasis and inherited urea cycle disorders
rationale: Members are urea cycle reactions, arginine/citrulline/ornithine metabolism, ammonium handling and the urea cycle enzyme deficiencies; confusables cover glutamate/glutamine/proline metabolism or cationic amino acid transport.

name: Bile acid synthesis via cholesterol catabolism
rationale: All members are routes converting cholesterol to bile acids (7alpha-, 24-, 27-hydroxycholesterol branches, CTX defect); confusables cover cholesterol biosynthesis, spastic paraplegia defects, or bile acid transport and signalling.

name: Collagen and elastic fibre formation, promoting matrix secretion and adhesion
rationale: Members cover collagen synthesis and crosslinking, elastic fibre assembly and positive regulation of ECM secretion, proteoglycan synthesis and endothelial-matrix adhesion; confusables add aortic development, elastin catabolism, basement membrane or collagen trimerization.

name: Polyamine metabolism and transport with eIF5A hypusination
rationale: Most members concern putrescine/spermidine/spermine synthesis, interconversion, ODC regulation and transport, with spermidine-derived hypusine and translational elongation; confusables are protein methylation/hydroxylation, tryptophan-NAD or methionine salvage.

name: Activated dendritic and T cell surface signatures with butyrophilins
rationale: Members are surface-marker modules of LPS-activated DCs and Th1-stimulated CD4 T cells plus butyrophilin interactions; confusables hold resting DC, monocyte and lipid antigen presentation signatures.

name: Anion exchangers, cation-chloride cotransporters and their inherited disorders
rationale: Members are bicarbonate, SLC26 anion, cation-chloride and sodium/proton exchangers with their genetic disease variants; confusables centre on CFTR, aquaporin water transport or carbonic anhydrase/pH regulation.

name: Gastrointestinal and urinary smooth muscle contraction and motility
rationale: Members cover smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, peristalsis, gastric motility, micturition and tachykinin signalling; confusables involve reproductive smooth muscle, serotonin or histamine receptors.

qualifier: fork reversal, R-loops and intra-S checkpoint
name: Replication stress response: fork reversal, R-loops, intra-S checkpoint
rationale: Members address stalled replication (fork reversal, R-loop processing, DNA-protein crosslink repair, hydroxyurea/camptothecin response) with checkpoint and p53 repair-gene control; confusables are homologous recombination repair or telomere maintenance.

qualifier: in membrane protrusions and cell motility
name: Actin filament dynamics shaping protrusions and cell motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerisation, severing, capping, crosslinking and bundling in filopodia, ruffles, podosomes and lamellipodia during migration; confusables are Rho-family GTPase cycles, WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 activation or focal adhesion signalling.

name: COPI intra-Golgi and retrograde endosome-Golgi-ER traffic
rationale: Members cover COPI vesicle budding, intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport, Golgi retention and early endosome-to-Golgi return; confusables are lysosomal vesicle biogenesis and Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome sorting.

name: BDNF-TrkB signalling and postsynaptic receptor endosomal trafficking
rationale: Members combine BDNF/NTRK2 signalling (CDK5, RAC1) with AMPA and neurotransmitter receptor endocytic recycling at the postsynapse; confusables address dendrite arborisation, presynaptic structure or synaptic plasticity outputs.

core: Protein glycosylation in ER and Golgi
qualifier: N-glycan glucose trimming and Notch O-fucose/O-glucose
name: N-glycan glucose processing and Notch O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation
rationale: Members cover glucosyl donor synthesis, N-glycan glucose/mannose trimming defects and O-fucosylation/O-glucosylation of Notch and TSR proteins; confusables are GAG/proteoglycan, dystroglycan, sialic acid or dolichol-oligosaccharide glycosylation.

name: Motor coordination and vocal learning behaviour, cerebellar-striatal development
rationale: Members are locomotion, proprioception, righting reflex, vocal/observational learning and auditory response with Purkinje layer and striatum development; confusables involve grooming, exploration, amygdala development or glycinergic transmission.

name: Atypical ubiquitin chain linkages and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members cover K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched ubiquitination, degron-rule degradation, deubiquitinases and ERAD/misfolded protein handling; confusables centre on proteasomal degradation regulation, K48 chains and protein destabilisation.

name: Regulation of myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion
rationale: All members regulate myoblast commitment, proliferation, migration, differentiation, fusion and myotube formation; confusables emphasise satellite cell activation, muscle regeneration or skeletal muscle fibre development.

name: Nephric duct and ureter epithelial tube morphogenesis
rationale: Members are nephric duct formation, ureter morphogenesis, mesonephros regulation and epithelial tube formation; confusables cover nephron patterning, ureteric bud branching or metanephros size.

name: SUMOylation of host and viral proteins, nucleocytoplasmic transport control
rationale: Members are the SUMO processing/conjugation cascade and its targets, viral nucleoprotein maturation and regulation of nuclear import/export; confusables cover nuclear pore assembly, nuclear envelope dynamics or PML body/senescence.

name: SRP-dependent cotranslational ER targeting and ER protein retention
rationale: Members cover signal-recognition-particle targeting, membrane insertion and ER lumen retention; confusables are COPI/COPII vesicle transport or ER quality control and ERAD.

qualifier: dermatan and heparan sulfate degradation (MPS I, II, VI)
name: Mucopolysaccharidoses I, II and VI, dermatan sulfate degradation
rationale: All members are Hurler, Hunter and Maroteaux-Lamy syndromes, defects in dermatan/heparan sulfate degradation; confusables are Sanfilippo and Morquio types or the normal GAG degradation pathways.

name: Rab and ARF GTPase regulation of synaptic endosomal recycling
rationale: Members combine Rab GAP/ARF signalling with synaptic vesicle and postsynaptic receptor endocytic recycling; confusables cover Rab GEFs and geranylgeranylation, AMPA receptor trafficking or presynaptic structure.
